mod = 998244353

def power(base, exp):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if (n * m) & 1:
    print(power(r - l + 1, n * m))
else:

    ans = (power(E + O, n * m) + power(E - O, n * m)) % mod
    inv2 = power(2, mod - 2)
    ans = (ans * inv2) % mod
    print(ans)
